title: Printables - Bouton de reglage climatisation Porsche 944 / 924 (model 1454674)

rights.attribution: Graalneox, Printables, CC0 (attribution given as courtesy)

notes: Licence read on 2026-11-05 from the platform's own record through the public Printables GraphQL API (query print(id: 1454674)): 'Creative Commons - Public Domain'. Published 2025-10-21. The author writes (French) that one of the two climate-control knobs of his 944 was missing and that he reproduced the part from the remaining one; it slides onto the protruding plastic stub and is pulled off; printed in PETG without supports. No dimension, instrument or tolerance is published. One file, 'bouton clim 944 ams.3mf', 45,337 bytes, SHA-256 5ed436dc293ab4734acd185536803ddd27a87e5d6c210e8fe2405aec2fa3fd75, inspected outside Git: one object, 1,336 triangles, envelope 19.97 x 10.00 x 12.50 file units, enclosed volume 1,395.9 cubic units: a stadium-shaped knob with a filleted crown and a pointer arrow. Applicability to the 993 rests only on SRC-LT3D-993-HEATER-KNOB (retailer, level B), which lists one knob reference, 944 653 205 00, for 944, 964, 968 and 993; no PET plate confirms it. Not committed.
